nodes.name: Ni foam pretreatment
nodes.procedure: A piece of commercial Ni foam substrate (4 × 1 cm²) was pretreated by ultrasonication in 2 M HCl solution for 20 min to remove the surface oxide layer, then washed with deionized water and ethanol in sequence, and the NF was dried at 60 °C and weighed.

nodes.name: Urea-modulated Ni2P/NF synthesis
nodes.procedure: The red P was dispersed into deionized water (30 mL) in a beaker, and then the urea (optimized 600 mg) was added into the aforementioned solution under stirring. The reaction mixture and the pre-treated Ni foam were transferred into a 40 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave, and the urea-modulated hydrothermal phosphorization reaction was performed for 24 h to achieve hierarchical Ni2P/NF.

nodes.name: CoMnP/Ni2P/NF-21 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 281 mg (1 mmol) CoSO4·7H2O, 98 mg (0.5 mmol) MnCl2·4H2O, 46.5 mg (1.5 mmol) red P, and 90 mg (1.5 mmol) urea were added to 30 mL deionized water under stirring (Co:Mn molar ratio 2:1). Ni2P/NF was immersed in this solution, transferred to 40 mL Teflon-lined autoclave, and hydrothermally treated for 24 h at 180°C. The product was washed with water and ethanol, then dried at 60°C for 12 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: Characteristic peaks of Ni₂P (PDF#03-0953), CoP (PDF#26-0481), and MnP (PDF#51-0942) phases well resolved for all catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the XRD patterns (Fig. 1b), the characteristic peaks corresponding to Ni₂P (PDF#03-0953), CoP (PDF#26-0481) and MnP (PDF#51-0942) phases can be well resolved.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF features hierarchical microplate arrays constructed from randomly oriented nanosheets with thickness of several micrometers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images (Fig. 1d–f) further confirm that the CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF features hierarchical microplate arrays constructed from randomly oriented nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms hierarchical microplate arrays from nanosheet assembly.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image of CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF (Fig. 1g) confirms its characteristic of hierarchical microplate arrays on NF from the assembly of nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.145 nm (311) CoP, 0.202 nm (021) MnP, and 0.210 nm (201) Ni₂P; interfaces between MnP and CoP phases observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image of CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF (Fig. 1h) shows three types of evident lattice fringe with interplanar spacings of 0.145, 0.202 and 0.210 nm, corresponding to the (311) lattice planes of CoP, (021) lattice planes of MnP, and (201) lattice planes of Ni₂P, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform distribution of Co, Mn, Ni, and P throughout CoMnP/Ni₂P nanosheets confirmed by EDX elemental mapping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image (Fig. 1i) with energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) elemental mapping (Fig. 1j) confirms the uniform distribution of Co, Mn, Ni, and P throughout the CoMnP/Ni₂P nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF shows Co 2p₃/₂ at 780.2 eV (Co³⁺) and 781.9 eV (Co²⁺) with 0.3 eV upshift vs CoP/Ni₂P/NF; Mn 2p₃/₂ at 638.9 eV (Mn²⁺), 642.4 eV (Mn³⁺, 0.4 eV downshift vs MnP/Ni₂P/NF), 647.1 eV (Mn⁴⁺); Ni 2p at 856.5/873.7 eV; P 2p at 130.5/131.1 eV (phosphides), 134.3 eV (phosphate).
nodes.evidence_snippet: From Fig. 2a, the signal from Co 2p₃/₂... can be divided into two spin-orbit doublets... The two main XPS peaks at 780.2 and 781.9 eV correspond to the 2p₃/₂ of Co³⁺ and Co²⁺... Compared with... CoP/Ni₂P/NF (779.9 eV), the Co 2p₃/₂ binding energy... up-shifts to 780.2 eV (0.3 eV).

nodes.characterization_summary: Water contact angle 0° (superhydrophilic); underwater gas bubble contact angle 158.0° ± 1.4° (superaerophobic).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The water contact angle values on NF and CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF were measured to be 121.7° and 0° (Fig. 3a and b)... The contact angle for underwater gas bubbles of CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF reached 158.0° ± 1.4°, indicating its remarkable superaerophobicity.

nodes.characterization_summary: Negligible bubble adhesive force on CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF surface (vs 36.6 μN on bare NF).
nodes.evidence_snippet: CoMnP/Ni₂P/NF shows a negligible bubble adhesive force between the bubble and the surface... Employing pristine Ni foam... a large bubble adhesive force of 36.6 μN (Fig. 3d).
